POWER MECHANICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. International Cricket Team

2. When learning Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Power Mechanics as a learning area.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

4. When learning Motor Vehicle Chassis, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Motor Vehicle Chassis.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Blending of lines and curves.

7. When learning Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Road wheels 3.2 Motor Vehicle body 3.3 Motor Vehicle chassis 3.4 Motor Vehicle b.

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

12. When learning General workshop rules and regulations 2.0 Related Technical Drawing 2 1. Diagon, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

14. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)

   B. Keyboard

15. When learning Road wheels, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
